titulo: Europe wildfires: more than 300,000 flee homes and holiday accommodation in France and Spain as fires rage
cuerpo: Fires displace people on massive scale and trigger one of the largest peacetime civilian evacuation operations ever carried out in France More than 250,000 people flee wildfires in France and Spain About 220,000 people have now been evacuated from the main forest fire raging in the south-west of France that threatens the city of Bordeaux , according to French authorities. The latest evacuations have been in villages around Bordeaux while 60km (37 miles) of the main A63 highway from Bordeaux to the Spanish border has been closed because of the fires, regional authorities said.
